mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 81 degrees near Harriet Park, with a waxing crescent moon phase visible later tonight.

The Verona Senior Center is recruiting volunteers to help with daily operations. Volunteers are asked to commit to at least two visits per month. Please note that some roles may involve physical activity like lifting or climbing stairs. You can find application forms at the front desk or online, and please remember that all volunteers must maintain strict confidentiality regarding participants.

There are plenty of things to do this weekend. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena or the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds.

In our weekly police update, an officer observed a driver on Wednesday, August 6, speeding and driving erratically. The driver was subsequently arrested for a fourth O W I offence and booked into jail.
Today's delicious flavor is Turtle. Culver's is open today until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
